_doc: Render tests out of scope (CLAUDE.md §2). A test is skipped if any rule matches; the first matching reason is reported. Also hard-coded in the runner: pitch != 0, roll != 0, non-mercator projection, and any metadata.test.operations other than wait/idle/sleep/redraw (runtime changes are out of scope).

source_encodings.mlt: MLT tile encoding; only MVT in scope

style_properties.font-faces: TTF font-faces; only PBF glyphs in scope
